q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an ointment tube?
title: Ointment carbon footprint per tube
short: Add the base ingredients and active per tube using supplier figures, the tube and carton, then the mixing, filling and clean room energy. Divide the plant's energy by tubes filled.

ul: Petrolatum, waxes, oils or cream base.
Laminated or aluminium tube and carton.
Heating and mixing in jacketed vessels.
Clean room air handling and packing.

p: Report per tube by fill weight. HVAC for clean areas can be a large share of plant energy.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per tube (one month)
lines: Plant total: 48,750 / 1,000,000 = 0.0488 kg CO2 per tube
Add ingredients, tube and carton for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
